episodes.title: Pilots and Nurses and Bears, Oh My!
episodes.summary: Nurse-out-of-water Hayley Roberts joins the fast-paced team of nurses and pilots at SkyMed, living and working together to fly air ambulances and save lives in rugged Northern Manitoba.

episodes.title: Line Indoc
episodes.summary: When a guilt-ridden Lexi finally goes flight line, she locks horns with training captain Bodie, while Crystal tries to get to the bottom of what Jeremy's been smuggling - and how it's connected to Wheezer's crash.

episodes.title: The Kids Are Alright
episodes.summary: Bodie struggles to come to terms with Madison's pregnancy, while Crystal wrestles with her past, and what it means for her future.

episodes.title: Where There's Smoke
episodes.summary: The investigation into Wheezer's crash puts Lexi in the hot seat. But when a wildfire threatens Crystal's community, will she cross the line to save a patient's life?

episodes.title: Bushwhacked
episodes.summary: Survival Training for the SkyMed crew takes a dangerous turn as simmering resentments boil over. Meanwhile, Crystal struggles with an unexpected hit-and-run patient with high-stakes consequences.

episodes.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
episodes.summary: Hayley seeks distraction from her own health concerns by throwing Emma a bachelorette party. But when a patient takes an unexpected turn, Hayley will be forced to face her fears.

episodes.title: Daj Mi Buzi
episodes.summary: Nowak stretches himself too thin with drastic consequences. Bodie struggles with an unexpected truth about his mother, while Crystal faces a shocking threat to her community.

episodes.title: Frozen
episodes.summary: A blizzard traps each of the team members with the person they least want to be stuck with in dire circumstances. As the temperature drops, emotions boil over.

episodes.title: Leave It All on the Ice
episodes.summary: Hayley struggles to make a life-altering decision, while Bodie reels from his son's premature birth. Crystal must deal with the consequences of Jeremy's actions once and for all.

episodes.title: Return to Base
episodes.summary: SkyMed expands its medevac service into new territory, throwing everyone into disarray as familiar faces return - and intriguing new flight crew arrive.

episodes.title: Spun Out
episodes.summary: As the SkyMed crew wait for their fallen team member to wake up, Crystal starts to find her feet as a medical student, and a secret from the past threatens Nowak and Tristan's relationship.

episodes.title: Things That Matter Most
episodes.summary: The SkyMed team must rally despite personal differences and challenges, to search for a missing medevac with four flight crew members aboard.

episodes.title: Turbulence
episodes.summary: As Chopper returns to flying medevacs, the truth about what happened in Selection Camp finally comes out; Lexi's dream promotion takes an unnerving turn.

episodes.title: Code Silver
episodes.summary: Shortages force the SkyMed flight nurses to staff the Thompson ER overnight, but a volatile patient throws the hospital into chaos.

episodes.title: Little Lies
episodes.summary: A fun night on the town creates unexpected consequences; a dangerous call with a paralyzed patient pushes Stef to finally reveal the secret that brought her to Thompson.

episodes.title: Old Wounds
episodes.summary: A sick patient hits close to home, leaving Crystal reeling; Hayley struggles to face the consequences of her actions when Wheezer discovers her secret.

episodes.title: Before Sunrise, After Sunset
episodes.summary: As the SkyMed team members face an inquiry into a patient fatality, Hayley struggles to piece together blurry memories of what caused her relapse - and whether she caused the fatality.

episodes.title: Out with a Bang
episodes.summary: As the pressure surrounding the SkyMed expansion comes to a head, a shocking emergency leaves one of the flight crew fighting for their life.

episodes.title: Arrivals, Departures
episodes.summary: The arrival of a prickly new Chief Nurse throws the whole SkyMed flight crew off-balance – until an unexpected accident causes a shocking loss.

episodes.title: The Fire
episodes.summary: As the SkyMed crew struggle to say a difficult goodbye to a fallen team member, the loss forces each of them to question themselves in different ways.

episodes.title: Ride Along
episodes.summary: A documentary crew arrives to follow the SkyMed flight crew, creating turbulence among the team – especially when Stef and Chopper are forced to work outside the lines on a difficult call.

episodes.title: Stuck
episodes.summary: As Crystal struggles through a typical day in the life of a med student, everyone else finds themselves forced to finally deal with the simmering problems they've been trying to ignore.

episodes.title: Marianncing the Stone
episodes.summary: When a camping trip with the cadets goes awry, Chopper and Marianne find themselves stranded together in the wilderness - and on an unexpected adventure.

episodes.title: Wheezervision
episodes.summary: After losing his vision, Wheezer is forced to entertain himself by imaging his pilots' lives in wild and fantastical movie genres.

episodes.title: Altitude
episodes.summary: When three of the flight crew are stranded on a plane with a bomb that will explode if they try to land, everyone on the ground races to try to save them.

episodes.title: Clarity
episodes.summary: Aviation Authority comes to investigate events in the SkyMed documentary, just as Marianne's secret past is revealed and Wheezer struggles with whether his vision will ever return.

episodes.title: Chasing Sunsets
episodes.summary: Bodie's wedding celebrations take an unexpected turn, forcing the SkyMed flight crew to race to save one of their own.

episodes.title: Incoming
episodes.summary: Chief Nurse Hayley and Chief Pilot Wheezer navigate new personalities and fresh drama as SkyMed auditions rookie medics and pilots to join the flight crew.

episodes.title: Team Building
episodes.summary: Hayley and Wheezer clash over management styles and the arrival of his ex-fiancée, as they try to shape the new medics and pilots into a team.

episodes.title: Kidneys Out
episodes.summary: When a kidney mysteriously disappears off a grounded SkyMed plane, the crew must scramble to find the organ while it's still viable.

episodes.title: Deadheading
episodes.summary: When an escaped convict mistakes Wheezer for a flight medic and abducts him to help his wounded partner, Wheezer must race to figure out how to keep the patient alive while trying to protect himself and his team from the dangerous felons.

episodes.title: Mercury Retrograde
episodes.summary: A grounded Stef works her first shift at the Whiskey Hatch and bonds with a psychic. Meanwhile, Crystal clashes with Zay over a judgement call, Maya crosses a line, and Hayley uncovers the truth about Piper.

episodes.title: 77 Hours
episodes.summary: Hayley races to stop Piper from fleeing with her brother. Meanwhile, Crystal and Zay fight for survival after being trapped in an abandoned mine, and Crystal must make a difficult decision with life or death consequences.

episodes.title: Aftermath
episodes.summary: Sheltering in place during a tornado warning, Crystal questions her decisions in the mine as Zay struggles to face his new reality, Lexi spirals when a patient triggers her fresh grief, and Piper must finally face what she's been running from.

episodes.title: Stick the Landing
episodes.summary: As SkyMed faces an uncertain fate, Wheezer must finally confront his fears, Stef returns to the field, Lexi and Maya wrestle with their ghosts, and Crystal and Hayley are pushed to make choices for the future.
